#Module fs

File handles (WHATWG File System, WICG File System Access; src/page/fs_store.odin, fs_api.odin; native/js/runtime/web_fs.c). A handle is a root (the origin private file system of the realm's storage key, or a folder of the user's disk given by a picker or a drop) and a "/"-joined path of names below it ("" is the root). Errors carry their DOMException's name first in the message ("TypeMismatchError: ...").

Exposed to: Window, Worker. Source: api/fs.widl.

#Functions

#Fs_opfsRoot

u64 Fs_opfsRoot(usvstring bucket) raises

navigator.storage.getDirectory(): the root of the realm's origin private file system. Security outside a secure context, for an opaque origin or a profile without a folder. bucket: a storage bucket's (StorageBucket.getDirectory), "" for the default one; Invalid_State once the bucket was deleted.

Raises: returns an Error (see web).

Host: Fs_opfsRoot :: proc(c: ^Call, bucket: string) -> (u64, Api_Error)

#Fs_getEntry

string Fs_getEntry(u64 root, string path, string name, bool directory, bool create) raises

getFileHandle / getDirectoryHandle(name, {create}) on the directory at path: the child's path. Not_Found, Type (an invalid name), Not_Allowed (no permission), Invalid_State ("TypeMismatchError": the other kind).

Raises: returns an Error (see web).

Host: Fs_getEntry :: proc(c: ^Call, root: u64, path: string, name: string, directory: bool, create: bool) -> (string, Api_Error)

#Fs_removeEntry

void Fs_removeEntry(u64 root, string path, string name, bool recursive) raises

removeEntry(name, {recursive}): Invalid_Modification for a directory that is not empty, No_Modification_Allowed for an entry in use.

Raises: returns an Error (see web).

Host: Fs_removeEntry :: proc(c: ^Call, root: u64, path: string, name: string, recursive: bool) -> Api_Error

#Fs_list

string Fs_list(u64 root, string path) raises

The directory's entries: "f" or "d", a tab, the name, one per line.

Raises: returns an Error (see web).

Host: Fs_list :: proc(c: ^Call, root: u64, path: string) -> (string, Api_Error)

#Fs_resolve

string Fs_resolve(u64 root, string path, u64 root2, string path2) raises

resolve(): the names from the first entry down to the second, "/"-joined (Not_Found: not below it).

Raises: returns an Error (see web).

Host: Fs_resolve :: proc(c: ^Call, root: u64, path: string, root2: u64, path2: string) -> (string, Api_Error)

#Fs_showPicker

Promise Fs_showPicker(i32 kind, string types, bool multiple, bool exclude_all, string suggested, string start_in, u64 start_root, string start_path, string id, bool readwrite) raises

showOpenFilePicker (kind 0), showSaveFilePicker (1), showDirectoryPicker (2): a promise of the number of handles, its text one line per handle: root TAB path TAB "f" or "d" TAB name. Abort when cancelled, Security without a user gesture, Not_Supported when disabled. types: a line per type, description TAB patterns...

Raises: returns an Error (see web).

Host: Fs_showPicker :: proc(c: ^Call, kind: i32, types: string, multiple: bool, exclude_all: bool, suggested: string, start_in: string, start_root: u64, start_path: string, id: string, readwrite: bool) -> (u64, Api_Error)
